description: Updates supplied name, type, schedule, venue, dress code or description fields for an identified event in the selected wedding. Omitted fields and existing invitations and responses remain unchanged. Null clears the end time, venue, address, dress code or description. Results identify saved changes with their previous values. Requires sign-in and an Aisle membership.

all_day.description: True for an all-day item with a day and no time, such as a travel day or a free day. Send date as the day (2027-06-12) and end_time as its last day for one that runs several days; a time sent with it is dropped.

date.description: Event start. A time with no offset, such as 2027-06-12T18:00, is the wedding's local time; one ending in Z or an offset is that exact instant.

description.description: Event description, or null to clear it

dress_code.description: Dress code (e.g. Black Tie, Smart Casual), or null to clear it

end_time.description: Event end time, read the same way as date., or null to clear it

event_id.description: Identifier of the event to update in the selected wedding.

venue_address.description: Venue address, or null to clear it

venue_name.description: Venue name for this event, or null to clear it

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: update_my_event
title: Update Wedding Event
